scope: The 26 circuit-related reports from the initial research result; retained with corrected assessments, not a claim that all are confirmed bugs.

benchmarks.reported_version_notes: Version(s) reported in the original issue environment; not a first-affected boundary.
benchmarks.assessment_notes: The initial wrong-inverse claim is qualified by the author and maintainer: StatePreparation only promises |0> -> |psi>, not a unique full-space unitary. String and vector inputs may validly choose different unitary extensions. Do not treat |+> vs |-> on inverse input |0> alone as a confirmed circuit-semantics bug.
benchmarks.resolution_notes: Issue remains open with discussion of consistency/documentation. No numerical fixed version is applicable or verified for the original claim.

benchmarks.assessment_notes: Small-angle RY/Pauli evolution can be treated inconsistently by commutation and identity-removal passes, leading to invalid entangling-gate cancellation.
benchmarks.resolution_notes: Merged fix #13874 aligns commutation-check fidelity thresholds and is verified in 2.0.0.
